rule.band: closed: a sample point at least half a reference pixel from every other-class square is outside the band
rule.k: a scored pixel holding a tile outside the band whose fit lies within margin_px of the wrong side, or within correction_tiles of a tile that may be of the other class (the game grows water into 2 x 2 blocks), at some offered scale, and every scored pixel with a pixel of the other class around it, so the coast follows the reference at the handler's write threshold everywhere; the scale's waterway footprint masks it there
rule.fill: a K pixel whose band region at the save's scale holds no 2 x 2 block of tiles is written whole; the handler decides it from the shared table
rule.pricing: the band rule's writes with the fit alone deciding (detail 0), every scored pixel, no masks, the map's own chunk grid (city offset 0)
rule.shipped: the shipped rule's writes with the fit alone deciding: K pixels outside the scale's masks, fill pixels whole
